status: INDICATIVE, NOT VALIDATED: APSIM-X process-model output, not calibrated for this site.

run.note: Series are read from the .db files of the run recorded in mambang_muda_latest.json (same run, not a new one).

weather.note: Years 2023-2025 are an Open-Meteo HINDCAST; the last partial year includes forecast days. Rain in rain_scaled scenarios is multiplied by the station/Open-Meteo ratio from 2023.

assumptions.planting_note: ASSUMED: palms planted 2012-01-01 (about 14.8 y old in Oct 2026); real block ages are unknown.
assumptions.management_note: Management scenarios differ from the base only from 2023; earlier years are identical.

unit_notes.ffb_t_ha: Fresh fruit bunch yield, t per ha per calendar year: the founder's manager sums the model's per-harvest HarvestFFB into Calculations.Script.AnnualYield.
unit_notes.soil_water_mm: Total soil water over the 2 m profile on the 1st of the month. It includes water below wilting point (sum of LL15 = 321.4 mm); field capacity (DUL) 546.9 mm, saturation 908.3 mm.
unit_notes.soil_nitrate_kg_ha: Total nitrate-N in the profile on the 1st of the month; the .db's _Units table does not state the unit, kg/ha is APSIM's usual unit for TotalNO3 (HYPOTHESIS).
unit_notes.n_leached_kg_ha: Nitrate-N leached below the profile, per year; unit not stated in _Units, kg/ha per the model source (HYPOTHESIS).
unit_notes.stem_mass_g_m2: Palm stem dry mass, a proxy for biomass (APSIM _Units: g/m^2). Other pools are not reported by the founder's file.

soil.note: available water = soil water minus LL15 (crop LL is unset in the founder's file); available water is capped at DUL (so the maximum is plant_available_water_mm); water above DUL is shown as water_above_dul_mm

limitations: INDICATIVE, NOT VALIDATED: the oil-palm model was not calibrated or checked against observations for Sumatra; yield here is a MODELLED value for comparing scenarios, not a forecast of harvests.
Only the Mambang Muda point is supported.
Scenario differences are model sensitivities (N rate x0.5 / x1.5, 3 vs 6 doses, irrigation rules), not recommendations.
Annual values exist for full years only (2012-2025); the 2026 partial year is given as yield to date and must not be annualised.

scenarios.label: As-is (planted 2012, assumed)
scenarios.description: Default. Palms planted 2012-01-01 (about 14.8 years old in Oct 2026, assumed), Open-Meteo weather as delivered.

scenarios.label: Older palms (planted 2008)
scenarios.description: Sensitivity: palms planted 2008-01-01 (about 18.8 years old), same weather.

scenarios.label: Younger palms (planted 2016)
scenarios.description: Sensitivity: palms planted 2016-01-01 (about 10.8 years old), same weather.

scenarios.label: Base (founder's management)
scenarios.description: Founder's N schedule unchanged (about 158.8 kg N/ha/yr at maturity, 3 doses 15 Jan/May/Sep), no irrigation.

scenarios.label: N fertiliser 0.5x
scenarios.description: Half the founder's N rate from 2023, same dates, no irrigation.

scenarios.label: N fertiliser 1.5x
scenarios.description: 1.5 times the founder's N rate from 2023, same dates, no irrigation.

scenarios.label: Same N, 6 doses/yr
scenarios.description: Founder's annual N rate split into 6 equal doses (15 Jan/Mar/May/Jul/Sep/Nov) instead of 3, no irrigation. The only leaching-related lever the model offers besides the N rate.

scenarios.label: Water top-up when fw < 0.9
scenarios.description: Founder's N. Rule: if yesterday's fw < 0.9 and 3+ days since the last top-up, apply 10 mm.

scenarios.label: Water top-up when fw < 0.8
scenarios.description: Founder's N. Rule: if yesterday's fw < 0.8 and 3+ days since the last top-up, apply 10 mm.
